errors.description: power_state_q is a multi-bit value produced in aon_clk and sampled directly in island_clk without a bundled-data handshake or hold guarantee.
wake_pulse_q is a one-cycle aon_clk pulse consumed directly in island_clk, so the event can be missed or sampled metastably.
wake_toggle_q reconverges with a one-sample island_clk history, allowing metastability or double-counting in island_event_o.
retention_sync_q receives independently synchronized bits from encoded control vector retention_q before decoding in island_clk, so transient illegal modes can be observed.
aon_rst_n is used as data inside island_clk logic, so reset deassertion can asynchronously change destination state.
sys_snapshot_q combines aon_clk payload state with island_clk status state in sys_clk without a cross-domain snapshot protocol.
